text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Woooow~! These buildings look so fantasy-like~! Just like the fairy village from the book~!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Fufu, this mountain has plenty of obstacle courses and all sorts of fun spots! Let's enjoy today to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Right. While we're here, want to take a commemorative photo? I'll snap one for you.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thanks! Then I'll go with... an innocent fairy pose!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Heh. Then how about I strike a "Forest Queen" pose?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Aah?! A-Actually, I want that one too!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: This suspension bridge... I suppose crossing straight down the middle is best. Craft, be careful not to slip.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Whoa-whoa-whoa, the wind is blowing up from underneath... Wonder if it'll sway...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: So exciting! Shall I see how many jumps it takes to cross the whole thing?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Phew~ that was delicious~! Today really turned into such a fun memory—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Wait, aaaaah?! The bus! The departure time for our bus home...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...The next bus won't make it back in time for curfew. It can't be helped. Let's contact the academy first and—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ............No, we're fine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: As horse girls, we still have another way! Cesario, Craft, are you ready to run?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Even though it's a mountain, downhill is a straight road. There are streetlights and guide signs too. Which means—we don't need a bus.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: With our legs—if we run, we'll definitely make it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Huh? All the way from here to the academy? True, it might just barely be possible, but...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Ummm, even if there are streetlights... you know... it's dark, nobody's around... and kinda creepy...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh, scared? Why not show off our running to the ghosts too then!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: If you're anxious, you can cling close to me, you know? Behind my back, that is.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mmh. Behind you...?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Put that way—I can hardly back down now.

text_block_list.name: All 3
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAH...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day at the academy, I noticed students chatting pleasantly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: And so you made it in time... honestly. I'm quite sure I reminded you beforehand to be mindful of curfew...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Tahaha... how embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh please. Giving up without even running when there's still a chance would be so boring, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: At least for someone aiming to be "Queen." Fufu.
